properties.title: M/V Champion Express adrift, Off Half Moon Bay, CA
properties.content: In the evening of 28-Feb-2013, the 628 foot M/V CHAMPION EXPRESS was reported adrift approximately 8NM West of Half Moon Bay, CA.  The loaded bulk cargo ship carrying liquid fertilizer had reported an engine leak that forced an engine shutdown.  At the time USCG contacted their NOAA SSC, she had been drifting for approximately 5 hours.  A tug was en route at the time of the call and expected to be on-scene in an hour or so.  USCG Sector SF requested a precautionary drift estimate of the ship in the event there is difficulty getting her under tow.   No pollution has been reported or is anticipated at this time.

2013-02-28
In the evening of 28-Feb-2013, the 628 foot M/V CHAMPION EXPRESS was reported adrift approximately 8NM West of Half Moon Bay, CA. At the time USCG contacted their NOAA SSC, she had been drifting for approximately 5 hours. A tug was en route at the time of the call and expected to be on-scene in an hour or so. USCG Sector SF requested a precautionary drift estimate of the ship in the event there is difficulty getting her under tow. No pollution has been reported or is anticipated at this time.

properties.title: TV Kaleen Mcallister, Baltimore, Maryland
properties.content:
MISLE CASE: 634869

DATE: 04 2231Q MAY 13

LOCATION OF INCIDENT: NORTHWEST TERMINAL, PIER 3

POB: 03  PFD'S: UNK

WX: WIND: 3-6 KTS, AIR TEMP: 59F, WATER TEMP: 59F, SEAS: 2 FT, VISIBILITY: 10 NM

SITUATION:  SSC RECEIVED REPORT FROM USCG SECTOR BALTIMORE THAT THE THE TOWING VESSEL KALEEN MCALISTER WAS TAKING ON WATER AND EXPERIENCING SEVERE FLOODING AT PIER 3, NORTHWEST TERMINAL.  THE VESSEL WAS UNABLE TO DEWATER USING THREE ONBOARD BILGE PUMPS. ACCORDING TO NRC REPORT 1046057, THE VESSEL STRUCK A SUBMERGED OBJECT WHILE GETTING UNDERWAY WHICH PIERCED THE VESSEL'S HULL COMMENCING WATER INTRUSION. THE VESSEL WAS MOORED AT NORTHWEST TERMINAL AND 03 POB WERE CONDUCTING DAMAGE CONTROL TO SECURE THE FLOODING. BALTIMORE CITY FIRE RESPONDED AND BROUGHT THE VESSEL ADDITIONAL PORTABLE BILGE PUMPS. DAN MARINE TOWING ALSO ASSISTED BY BRINGING THE VESSEL A TOTAL OF 5 PORTABLE BILGE PUMPS. 03 POB SECURED FUEL VENTS AND VALVES PRIOR TO DEPARTING VESSEL ONCE IT BECAME APPARENT THE VESSEL WOULD SINK. 03 POB DISEMBARKED THE VESSEL. VESSEL HAS 18,000 GALLONS OF DIESEL AND ABOUT 600 GALLONS OF LUBE OIL. SCC NOTIFIED RESPONSE AND LAUNCHED STA CB. STA CB ARRIVED O/S AND PROVIDED VISUAL IMAGERY AND OFFICER PRESENCE.  SCC NOTIFIED CID AND PREVENTION.  MCALLISTER CONTACTED OSRO, MILLER ENVIRONMENTAL, AND SALVAGE COMPANY TO DEPLOY BOOM AND PREPARE SALVAGE PLAN. USCG ON-SCENE. IT HAS BEEN REPORTED THAT FUEL IS SLOWLY LEAKING FROM VESSEL, APPROXIMATELY 10-15 GALLONS REPORTED TO BE LEAKING. DIVERS ARE ON SCENE AND CONDUCTING UNDER WATER EXAM.

RESPONDING: BALTIMORE CITY FIRE AND POLICE, MILLER ENVIRONMENTAL, ENVIRONMENTAL RECOVERY COPORATION, AND MARYLAND DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENT.
